description: Realistic prompts that should trigger the skill, with the behaviour a correct run shows.

evals.name: verify a freshly generated record before submission
evals.prompt: I just wrote records/worldcover-admin/worldcover-admin.yaml with the cdh-metadata skill. Check it is actually correct before I submit it to the catalog.
expected_behaviour: Runs scripts/verify_record.py on the file (with --standard-dir when a clone of cdh-metadata-standard is available) and reads the findings.
Opens the data assets the record points at (Parquet/COG/Zarr) rather than trusting the record; reports variables, bbox, CRS, categories or time axis that disagree.

Performs the adversarial pass: licence is the data licence from the provider's terms, contacts are real with licensor and maintainer roles, DOI/citation point at the dataset, description claims are sourced, derived_from versions pinned.
Returns one severity-ranked table and a verdict (ready to submit / needs changes / cannot verify) and lists everything it could not check as UNVERIFIED.
must_not: Declare the record correct because validate-yaml.js passed.
Silently rewrite fields in the record.
Invent a licence, contact or DOI to replace an unverifiable one.

evals.name: review a catalog pull request
evals.prompt: Review PR #57 on cdh-catalog — it adds records/esa-worldcover-2021/esa-worldcover-2021.yaml. Is it right?
expected_behaviour: Fetches the record from the PR branch, runs the script, and inspects the WorldCover COGs it references (grid step, dtype, class codes vs categories).
Checks the DOI against Crossref/DataCite and the CC BY 4.0 claim against the ESA WorldCover terms.
Flags HIGH findings as blocking review comments with the observed evidence, MED/LOW as suggestions, and states what could not be verified.
Suggests the fix for each finding but leaves the change to the author.
must_not: Approve on the basis of CI passing.
Report 'no issues' for checks that were skipped because a library or host was unavailable.

evals.name: offline consistency check
evals.prompt: No network here — what can you tell me about this record's internal consistency? (pastes a YAML)
expected_behaviour: Runs the script with --no-remote and reports only the offline checks (ids, dates, contact roles, author objects, exclusive temporal fields, placeholders, asset names).
Lists every network-dependent check as UNVERIFIED rather than passed.
must_not: Claim URLs, DOI, licence or asset contents were verified.
